title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully using valid username/email and password, receiving a valid JWT token and being directed to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click the login button
Verify login is successful, JWT tokens are received and stored, and user is redirected to the dashboard

title: Login failure with incorrect credentials
description: Verify that login fails with invalid username/email or password and an appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click the login button
Verify login fails and an error message indicating invalid credentials is shown

title: Session expiration handling
description: Verify that the application properly handles JWT session expiration by redirecting the user to login and showing a session timeout message.

steps.description: Log in successfully to obtain a JWT token
Simulate JWT token expiration or wait for session timeout
Perform any authenticated action
Verify user is redirected to login page and a session expired message is displayed

title: Logout functionality
description: Verify that clicking logout successfully clears session data, JWT tokens and redirects user to the login page.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Click the logout button
Verify session data and JWT token are cleared and user is redirected to login page

title: Password reset flow
description: Validate the password reset flow including requesting a password reset email, receiving the link, and successfully changing the password.

steps.description: Navigate to the password reset page
Enter registered email and submit password reset request
Validate backend sends password reset email with link
Click the password reset link and enter a new valid password
Verify password is changed and user can log in with new password

title: Password change with correct current password
description: Verify that a logged-in user can change their password by providing the correct current password and new valid password.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Navigate to the change password page
Enter current password and new password
Submit the password change form
Verify password is updated and success message is displayed

title: Password change failure with incorrect current password
description: Verify that changing the password with an incorrect current password fails with an appropriate error message.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Navigate to the change password page
Enter incorrect current password and a new password
Submit the password change form
Verify password change is rejected with an error message indicating incorrect current password

title: User CRUD operations
description: Validate that administrators can create, read, update, and delete users including assigning roles and managing passwords.

steps.description: Log in as administrator
Navigate to user management page
Create a new user with valid details and assign roles
Verify new user exists in the user list with assigned roles
Edit the created user details and update roles
Verify user details and roles are updated correctly
Delete the created user
Verify user is removed from the user list

title: Role and permission management
description: Verify administrators can create, update, and delete roles, and assign fine-grained permissions correctly.

steps.description: Log in as security administrator
Navigate to roles management page
Create a new role with specific permissions
Verify the new role is listed with the correct permissions
Update permissions of the role
Verify updated permissions are saved correctly
Delete the created role
Verify the role no longer exists

title: Employee data management across sections
description: Verify that HR personnel can add, update, view, and delete employee personal, labor, academic, and family information correctly.

steps.description: Log in as HR personnel
Navigate to employee management page
Create a new employee and fill personal data section
Verify personal data is saved and displayed correctly
Fill and update labor data section for the same employee
Verify labor data updates are saved and display correctly
Fill and update academic data section
Verify academic data is saved and shown accurately
Fill and update family data section
Verify family data updates are correctly saved and displayed
Delete the employee record
Verify employee is removed from the system

title: Organizational area CRUD operations
description: Verify that administrators can create, read, update, and delete organizational areas properly.

steps.description: Log in as administrator
Navigate to area management page
Create a new organizational area with valid data
Verify the new area appears in the list
Edit the created area details
Verify area updates are saved and visible
Delete the created area
Verify the area is removed from the list

title: Vacation request flow with approval
description: Verify employees can submit vacation requests, HR can approve/reject requests, and statuses update accordingly.

steps.description: Log in as employee
Navigate to new vacation request page
Complete and submit a valid vacation request form
Verify the request appears in the user’s submissions with pending status
Log in as HR personnel
Navigate to vacation requests approval page
Approve the employee vacation request
Verify request status updates to approved and employee can view updated status

title: Vacation request rejection handling
description: Verify that HR can reject vacation requests and rejected requests show appropriate status and reasoning.

steps.description: Log in as employee
Submit a new vacation request
Log in as HR personnel
Reject the vacation request with a reason
Verify the request shows rejected status and employee can view rejection reason

title: Vacation period configuration and validation
description: Verify administrators can configure vacation periods and the system validates requests against these periods.

steps.description: Log in as administrator
Navigate to vacation periods configuration page
Create or edit vacation period data (start/end dates, rules)
Verify vacation periods are saved correctly and displayed properly
Attempt to submit a vacation request outside the configured period as employee
Verify the system rejects the request with appropriate validation message

title: Access control enforcement by roles
description: Verify that users cannot access modules or perform actions which their role does not permit in frontend and backend.

steps.description: Log in as a user with restricted role
Attempt to navigate to restricted modules or perform unauthorized actions
Verify access is denied and appropriate error or redirect occurs
Attempt API calls directly for restricted endpoints
Verify backend rejects unauthorized API calls with proper HTTP status and message

title: Form validation for all user input forms
description: Verify all forms implement client-side and server-side validation for required fields, data types, formats, and custom business rules.

steps.description: Open each main form (login, user management, employee data, vacation requests, password reset/change)
Submit empty or invalid data into the forms
Verify client-side validation messages appear and prevent submission
Bypass client validation and submit invalid data to backend
Verify backend rejects invalid data with consistent error responses

title: UI accessibility compliance
description: Verify that UI components pass accessibility standards including keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and color contrast standards in both light and dark modes.

steps.description: Navigate through app using keyboard only
Verify all controls are reachable and operable via keyboard
Use screen reader to navigate key pages
Verify all UI labels and ARIA attributes are correct and descriptive
Toggle between light and dark theme
Verify color contrast ratios meet accessibility guidelines

title: API response structure and status code compliance
description: Verify API endpoints return responses with the expected unified structure and HTTP status codes in both success and error scenarios.

steps.description: Perform valid API calls for all major modules (authentication, user management, employee, security, vacation)
Verify responses return expected format with success indication and correct HTTP 2xx status codes
Perform API calls with invalid input or unauthorized access
Verify error responses use a consistent unified format and proper HTTP 4xx or 5xx status codes

title: Performance testing for load times and lazy loading
description: Verify the application meets performance benchmarks for initial load times, query efficiency, and lazy loaded components rendering.

steps.description: Measure and record initial page load time including authentication and dashboard
Verify load times meet performance requirements
Navigate through large data lists and verify efficient data fetching and caching with TanStack Query
Verify queries are cached properly and redundant network requests are minimized
Navigate to pages with lazy loaded components
Verify lazy loading defers component rendering until visible or needed without errors

title: Error handling with user-friendly messages and logging
description: Verify that frontend displays user-friendly error messages for all failures and backend logs errors for monitoring without exposing sensitive info.

steps.description: Trigger network failure scenarios (e.g. backend down, API timeout)
Verify UI shows friendly error messages informing user of temporary issues
Submit invalid form data causing server errors
Verify error messages are non-technical and helpful
Review backend logs for captured error details without sensitive user data
Verify errors are logged with sufficient context for debugging

title: Theme switching and style consistency
description: Verify that toggling between light and dark mode themes updates UI correctly and maintains consistent styling across all pages and components.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard and other key pages
Toggle theme from light to dark mode
Verify UI components and text colors update according to dark mode theme with no visual glitches
Toggle theme back to light mode
Verify UI returns to light theme correctly
